title: CFIUS Presidential Orders
excerpt: Every presidential order that prohibits or unwinds a foreign acquisition under Section 721 of the Defense Production Act, 1990 to now, one row per order, newest first.
footnote: Not rows: Section 721 presidential documents that do not prohibit a transaction — EO 13456 (2008), EO 14083 (2022), the 2006 Alcatel–Lucent order, and the 2025 TikTok framework order (“Saving TikTok While Protecting National Security”). The 2020 ByteDance / Musical.ly order is the prohibition; the 2025 order is a framework for a later deal. Count checked against CRS In Focus IF10177.

entries.label: CFIUS Order Regarding the Acquisition of Certain Assets of EMCORE Corporation by HieFo Corporation
entries.text:
HieFo and its Affiliates must divest all interests and rights in the Emcore Assets within 180 calendar days after the order date, unless CFIUS extends the deadline.
Until divestment is completed and verified, HieFo must not grant unauthorized access to the Emcore Assets or related non-public information, systems, products, records, or facilities.
HieFo must notify CFIUS of an intended buyer or transferee and wait 30 calendar days without a CFIUS objection before completing a sale or transfer.
HieFo must certify weekly to CFIUS that it and its Affiliates comply with the order and describe divestment efforts until divestment certification.
CFIUS must complete verification within 90 calendar days after receiving the divestment certification and then notify HieFo in writing when divestment is complete.

fields.target: Certain assets of EMCORE Corporation, comprising its digital chips and related wafer design, fabrication, and processing businesses (Emcore Assets)

entries.label: CFIUS Order Regarding the Acquisition of Certain Real Property of Cheyenne Leads by MineOne Cloud Computing Investment I L.P.
entries.text:
Sell or transfer all direct and indirect legal and beneficial ownership interests or other rights in the Real Estate and certify completion in writing within 120 calendar days.
Within 90 calendar days, remove all stockpiled, stored, deposited, installed, or affixed equipment from the Real Estate and certify completion in writing.
Within 90 calendar days, remove specified utility improvements, underground work, and above-ground construction or improvements begun after closing, and certify completion in writing.
Refrain from physical or logical access to the Real Estate, Equipment, or Improvements until divestment and removals are completed and verified, except as necessary to carry out the order.
Notify CFIUS of an intended buyer or transferee and wait 10 business days without a CFIUS objection before completing a sale or transfer.

fields.acquirer: MineOne Cloud Computing Investment I L.P.
fields.target: Certain real property of Cheyenne Leads: 12.06 acres at 635 Logistics Drive, Cheyenne, Wyoming, within 1 mile of Francis E. Warren Air Force Base

entries.label: CFIUS Order Regarding the Acquisition of Four U.S. Wind Farm Project Companies by Ralls Corporation
entries.text:
Ralls must divest all interests in the Project Companies and their assets, intellectual property, technology, personnel, and customer contracts within 90 days after the order date, unless CFIUS extends the period by up to three months.
Within 14 calendar days after the order date, the Companies must remove all items, structures, and installations they placed on the identified Properties and provide CFIUS a signed removal certification.
The Companies and persons acting for them must cease all access to the identified Properties, subject to the stated exception for approved U.S. citizen contractors performing removal.
Ralls must notify CFIUS of an intended buyer and may not complete a sale or transfer until the required removal verification and CFIUS review conditions are satisfied.

fields.target: Lower Ridge Windfarm, LLC; High Plateau Windfarm, LLC; Mule Hollow Windfarm, LLC; and Pine City Windfarm, LLC (the Project Companies), including their assets

entries.label: CFIUS Order Regarding the Acquisition of Jupiter Systems, LLC by Suirui International Co., Limited
entries.text:
The Transaction is prohibited, and the Purchasers’ ownership of interests in Jupiter or its non-excepted assets is prohibited.
Within 120 calendar days after the order date, the Purchasers must divest all interests and rights in Jupiter and covered assets, subject to CFIUS extension or conditions.
Until divestment is completed and verified, the Purchasers must not access Jupiter’s specified non-public information, systems, products, records, or U.S. facilities unless CFIUS approves.
Within 7 calendar days after the order date, the Purchasers and Jupiter must establish CFIUS-required controls preventing prohibited access.
The Purchasers and Jupiter must provide weekly compliance certifications until the Purchasers certify completion of the divestment.

fields.target: Jupiter Systems, LLC (subsequently converted to Jupiter Systems, Inc.)
